title: Use Case of the Week: Chat to PPT
body_markdown:
Today, we’re introducing Chat to PPT fromModel ML : go from a prompt to a client-ready presentation, in your exact format, in minutes.


Chat to PPT lets you describe what you need in natural language, then generates a full presentation that already looks like it came from your team.


For teams producing client-facing materials, speed no longer comes at the expense of quality. Chat to PPT gets you to a clean V1 fast, so your time goes into the thinking, not the formatting.
